## SessionOrigin

Supporting declaration used by a public type. This is not an additional runtime API or SDK helper.

Where a session came from in the hub. Absent on chats started outside it.

```ts
export interface SessionOrigin {
    mode: HubMode;
    lessonId?: string;
    topicId?: string;
    planId?: string;
    skipProbe?: boolean;
}
```

**Related types:** [HubMode](contracts-hub.md#hubmode).
